advice.moderate: Izinga eliphakathi. Abantu abazwelayo kumele banciphe ukuchatshazelwa.
advice.sensitive: Ayifanelanga amaqela azwelayo. Nxiba isifonyo ukuba kuyafuneka.

about.title: Malunga ne-Mframapa AI
about.overview.desc: I-Mframapa AI iqikelela i-PM2.5 imihla ngemihla kumazwe angama-54 ase-Afrika.
about.overview.problem_desc: Amadolophu amaninzi ase-Afrika awanayo izixhobo zokubeka umoya. Sivalela esi sikhewu.
about.how.step1.title: Ii-Satellite Njengezisensa
about.how.step1.desc: Ukusebenzisa idatha ye-ESA Sentinel-5P ne-NASA MERRA-2.
about.how.step2.title: Ukulungiswa Komhlaba
about.how.step2.desc: Imodeli iqeqeshwe kwizikhululo ezingama-398 kumazwe angama-29.
about.how.step3.title: Ukuqikelela Kwelizwekazi
about.how.step3.desc: Imodeli ye-XGBoost iqikelela i-PM2.5 kweyiphi na indawo yase-Afrika.
about.limit.gap_desc: Ukudlula kwee-satellite imihla ngemihla kunokuphoswa ukuphakama okufutshane.
